versions.changelog:
- Initial early release of the model-citizen skill for agent accountability.
- Provides verifiable Ed25519 identity tied to the principal using the Agent Passport System.
- Supports scoped, narrowing authority delegation and Ed25519-signed receipts for every action.
- Ensures receipts are auditable across sessions, agents, and handoffs without issuer trust.
- API and install instructions provided for both SDK and remote MCP server usage.
- Functionality and capabilities are expected to expand in future updates.
